title: From Recursion to Convolution: Parallel Self-Improvement for Multi-Agent Systems
abstract: arXiv:2611.20891v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Multi-agent self-improvement enables agents to improve through interaction and feedback. However, sequential dependencies across agents and refinement rounds can propagate errors, increase computational costs, and limit parallelism. Moreover, refining individual features or agents in isolation can overlook their dependencies and restrict collective coordination. To address these challenges, we propose ConvRSI, a framework for parallelizing multi-agent self-improvement through convolution. ConvRSI couples intra-agent convolution, which jointly refines related agent features, with inter-agent graph convolution, which aggregates messages according to the collaboration topology. Both stages operate in latent space, enabling parallel updates without repeatedly decoding and re-encoding intermediate messages. Experiments on MATH-500 show that ConvRSI achieves 5.04% performance improvement while reducing 17.27% inference cost, and 45.11% latency

translated_title: 从递归到卷积：多智能体系统的并行自我改进
translated_abstract: 多智能体自我改进使智能体能够通过交互和反馈不断提升自身。然而，智能体之间和改进轮次之间的顺序依赖可能导致错误传播、增加计算成本并限制并行性。此外，孤立地改进单个特征或单个智能体可能会忽视它们之间的依赖关系，并限制集体协调能力。为应对这些挑战，我们提出了ConvRSI，一个通过卷积实现多智能体自我改进并行化的框架。ConvRSI将智能体内卷积（联合改进相关的智能体特征）与智能体间图卷积（根据协作拓扑结构聚合消息）相结合。两个阶段均在潜在空间中运行，实现并行更新而无需反复解码和重新编码中间消息。在MATH-500上的实验表明，ConvRSI在实现5.04%性能提升的同时，降低了17.27%的推理成本和45.11%的延迟。
tldr: ConvRSI通过在潜在空间中结合智能体内卷积与智能体间图卷积，实现多智能体自我改进的并行化，在MATH-500上取得5.04%性能提升的同时显著降低推理成本和延迟。
en_tdlr: ConvRSI parallelizes multi-agent self-improvement by coupling intra-agent and inter-agent graph convolutions in latent space, achieving a 5.04% performance gain on MATH-500 while reducing inference cost by 17.27% and latency by 45.11%.
